acs.text_first_line: Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the decision records of agent version "P2" for 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-14
Given the rwb-comms contract mock returns an accepted reference for MSG-P10-006
Given the rwb-reporting contract mock returns the published token and cost measures for "INTAKE" for November 2026
Given "SCREENING" for MORTGAGE and BKK has 12 feedback entries in the week to 2026-12-14
Given the DRIFT alert for "INTAKE", "MORTGAGE/BKK" and 2026-12-14 exists

ops_provided: GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-metrics (v2 element: the v1 members plus segment, mode, acceptanceRate, correctionRate, overrideRate, feedbackCount and reconciled; the two filter refusals; the held-date status)
GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-runs (baseline RWB-P10-E1063-CON, used as the run drill-down)
GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs (baseline RWB-P10-E1063-CON, used by the screen)
ops_consumed: rwb-decision GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log (agent version, recommendation, final call, override reason; agent-version filter not specified)
rwb-case GET /api/recovery/case/v1/admin/lists/{listCode} (LOV-PRODUCT, LOV-REGION, LOV-AGENT, LOV-AGENT-ALERT, LOV-ROLE)
rwb-comms POST the notification operation (path not specified; MSG-P10-006)
workflows: AgentRunDailyRollupWorkflow (the v1 workflow, extended with the agentDrift step; Schedule AgentRunDailyRollup, namespace rwb-recovery, queue rwb-agent, workflow ID = business date, 01:30 Asia/Bangkok, overlap SKIP, catch-up one business date)
agentDrift (activity, new; the legacy agentDrift step of JOB-15)
